scope.objective: Fresh official-source audit of MAP-KG / MAP for provenance-bound knowledge-layer research in MAESTRO.
scope.reading_depth: Targeted official full-text Methods, benchmark and screening sections, Extended Data Figures 1-2, supplementary A.5/A.10 and Tables 19-21, and six inspected public implementation files. Not an exhaustive scientific or software reproduction.
excluded: No duplicate full CSV download; coverage/schema audit is a separate parent-owned artifact
scope.inspection_vs_execution: Code findings are static inspection of the pinned public revision. Published checkpoints, original training logs, and exact author's execution path were not run.

paper.title: A knowledge-driven framework for predicting single-cell responses for unprofiled drugs

dataset.freshness: A new fetch confirms this revision; the sparse card still says 'We will release MAP-KG data soon', although four CSV assets are present.
dataset.actual_csv_counts_and_coverage: Counts, schema and menu coverage are recorded in outputs/knowledge_layer_validation_20261009/AUDIT.json and independently reconstructed in VERIFIED.json. This paper/source audit did not independently repeat full CSV coverage; release counts must not be substituted for paper counts.

code.freshness: Fresh metadata/tree fetch agrees with the previously inspected revision; no newer implementation was established by this audit.

checkpoint_release.status: Advertised by official README, not independently downloaded or checksum-verified.
checkpoint_release.claim: README advertises multi-modal knowledge encoders and perturbation prediction model weights.
checkpoint_release.limitation: No authoritative per-checkpoint provenance, manifest, architecture compatibility, dataset split or exclusion certificate was validated.

supplement.page_number_convention: One-based PDF pages; printed supplementary pagination differs.

licensing_scope.interpretation: These license declarations apply to separate assets. A dataset-card declaration does not certify all upstream-source or checkpoint rights.

published_graph.relation_form: Natural-language edge description plus optional numeric strength/confidence. Paper says all graph edges are directed.
evidence_quality: Sources mix measured binding, curated annotations, literature-derived relations, and predicted/functional associations.
Supplement A.10 explicitly calls Human PPI predicted; STITCH and STRING include known and predicted interactions.
Directed graph storage does not by itself establish causal evidence, signed regulatory effect, or cell-context-specific target engagement.

embedding_mechanism.published_freezing: MoleculeSTM and ESM-2 frozen; trainable modality adaptation heads; biomedical text encoder participates in alignment.
embedding_mechanism.canonical_entity_anchor: Embedding of the entity name text; each entity's attributes align to its own name anchor.
embedding_mechanism.shared_space: All projected attributes and relation-conditioned entity compositions occupy a shared d-dimensional space.

ordered_relation_composition.interpretation: Ordered concatenation through an MLP distinguishes source and target roles.
not_claimed: No indiscriminate collapse of linked drug and protein embeddings to the same entity

alignment.intra_node: Randomly sampled text, molecule or protein attributes align to that same entity's canonical name.
alignment.inter_node: A relation-conditioned representation aligns with its linked neighboring entity.
alignment.public_implementation: GatedFusion with ordered inputs; source/target conditioning randomly selected; normalized cosine logits in both directions; same-endpoint groups form soft labels normalized by F.normalize(labels, dim=0), then soft cross-entropy.
alignment.technical_caution: Inspecting this normalization is not a proof of exact equivalence to a textbook probability-target InfoNCE implementation; the inspected code uses the default L2 F.normalize, not an explicitly specified L1 probability normalization.

negatives.actual_supervision: Contrastive minibatch negatives / non-existing graph edges, rather than authenticated no-effect experimental pairs.
negatives.figure_reading: Extended Fig. 1 shows a gray 'non-existing edge' being pushed away.
negatives.limitation: Missing graph edges cannot be treated as experimentally observed absence of binding, no transcriptional response, no efficacy, or safety.

embedding_mechanism.quantitative_scores: The inspected dataloader selects only endpoint identifiers and relation text for drug-gene edge sampling. Optional numeric affinity/confidence is not used in the inspected loss path.
embedding_mechanism.caption_inconsistency: Extended Fig. 1 caption swaps inter/intra wording relative to Methods. This audit follows the operational definitions in Methods.

public_implementation_gaps.paper: Graph construction and knowledge ablations describe gene-gene relations.
public_implementation_gaps.inspected_code: DrugGeneKG_Dataset and train_resume receive drug-node, gene-node and drug-gene CSVs only; no gene-gene sampler/argument was found in the inspected path.
public_implementation_gaps.implication: Do not assume running this public path includes the published complete graph pretraining.
public_implementation_gaps.conclusion_scope: Absence in this inspected path; not proof the author training lacked gene-gene supervision.

public_implementation_gaps.paper: Canonical amino-acid sequences encoded by ESM-2.
public_implementation_gaps.inspected_code: An external gene-symbol-to-ESM lookup tensor is required at a placeholder path; the dataloader's ESM column selects the lookup branch.
public_implementation_gaps.implication: Need an authenticated lookup with gene identity, sequence/version, dimension and order manifest for compatible reuse.

public_implementation_gaps.paper: Drug embedding is scaled by log-transformed dose before downstream prediction (Methods, equation 8 context).
public_implementation_gaps.inspected_code: PerturbationEncoder.forward accepts concs but its body never uses it; MAP/model/model.py passes encode_conc=False.
public_implementation_gaps.implication: The inspected path cannot substantiate dose-responsive predictions or exact reproduction of the dose-conditioned published method.
public_implementation_gaps.conclusion_scope: Implementation-to-paper discrepancy; no inference about uninspected checkpoint training code.

public_implementation_gaps.paper: STATE gene tokens are fused with knowledge-informed projected protein representations (Methods, equation 7).
public_implementation_gaps.inspected_code: Public downstream gene fusion concatenates STATE 2048-dimensional tokens with ESM 5120-dimensional features into a separate residual projector; no explicit pretrained KG gene projector is loaded in this inspected path. The pretrained molecular KG encoder is explicitly loaded.
public_implementation_gaps.implication: Verify original compatible forward and checkpoint mappings before claiming published multimodal knowledge transfer.

public_implementation_gaps.inspected_code: Knowledge training defaults resume_from to ./checkpoints/kg_v3/best_model.pt, uses site-specific/placeholder external lookup paths, and downstream KG checkpoint is path/to/your/pretrained/kg/encoder/best_model.pt.
public_implementation_gaps.implication: The public code is a reproducibility starting point, not a self-contained runnable release with verified original assets.

evidence_sections: Zero-shot generalization across unseen cell line–drug combinations
Biological knowledge enhances zero-shot generalization to unprofiled drugs
published_validation.supported_task: Within-dataset prediction of drug-induced single-cell RNA responses, evaluated at pseudobulk resolution.

protocols.name: unseen_cell_drug_pair
protocols.held_out: 5% drugs per cell line; held-out drug sets non-overlapping across lines
protocols.what_remains_seen: Every held-out drug appears in training in other cellular contexts

protocols.name: unprofiled_drug
protocols.held_out: 5% drugs removed entirely from perturbation training; 16 Tahoe test compounds
protocols.kg_exclusion_claim: Held-out drug entities, aliases and incident edges excluded from knowledge pretraining
protocols.claim_boundary: Compound transfer in already represented cellular datasets; exclusion claim not independently reconstructed from author's training inputs

published_validation.cross_dataset_evidence: Methods / Datasets explicitly says all experiments are conducted within each dataset (no cross-dataset evaluation).
published_validation.gene_selection_boundary: HVGs selected per dataset; top-50 DEGs use experimental condition-specific differential expression. Such evaluation does not certify accuracy for a prospectively known universal DEG set.
published_validation.knowledge_ablation: Paper reports added-knowledge improvements and category removal decreases; drug-gene relation removal produces the largest reported drop in DEG direction/delta correlation.
published_validation.statistical_unit: Figures summarize n=5 independent evaluations on the same held-out test set, with unadjusted two-sided Welch tests against the second-best method.
published_validation.statistical_boundary: Five evaluations on a common held-out test set do not establish independent prospective biological replication.

screening_validation_boundary.published_setup: Simulated in silico screen of 58 held-out candidate drugs in A-549.
screening_validation_boundary.decision_score: GSEA on predicted RNA responses; aggregate disease-relevant pathway enrichment into drug-level downregulation score.
validation: Top-k retrieval of clinically approved drugs
not_established_by_paper: Prospective efficacy, viability or survival outcome measured for model-selected interventions
Calibrated expected value of sample information or regret
Cell- and condition-specific potency, target occupancy or safety guarantee
screening_validation_boundary.implication: Pathway-aligned RNA ranking is useful mechanistic evidence; it does not directly certify therapeutic response or downstream decision utility.

computational_resources.reuse_boundary: Released compatible encoders can avoid knowledge pretraining, but dataset-specific response fitting or finetuning and compatible identity/axis handling remain necessary.

agent_layer: Resolve compound and gene identities exactly; preserve aliases, structure identity and raw provenance.
Retrieve source-backed mechanisms with directed source/relation/target semantics and explicit evidence quality.
Generate falsifiable mechanism hypotheses and identify missing context-specific evidence.
Prioritize evidence collection using uncertainty or downstream value only when these quantities are independently validated.
world_model_layer: Evaluate a modest shared-embedding adapter or conditional mechanistic residual against a fixed RNA baseline.
Condition response predictions explicitly on cell/background, dose, exposure time and assay.
Keep provenance, evidence strength and calibrated uncertainty separate from embedding geometry.
Use only verified assets, gene/drug axes, and a compatible original forward path for reproduction; record deliberate deviations as new implementations.
avoid_inherited_claims: Embedding cosine is not binding affinity, potency, target occupancy or cell-specific causal effect.
Natural-language inhibitor/activator relation alone is not a measured sign or magnitude of downstream RNA/viability response.
Knowledge encoder reuse alone does not create a response world model.
MAP RNA gains do not automatically transfer to agent value, calibrated EVSI, risk certification or matched functional outcomes.
minimal_validation_gates: Authenticate exact molecular/protein identity, source versions, raw relation evidence and released asset compatibility.
Audit held-out drug/alias/edge exclusions independently before claiming strict unseen-drug generalization.
Compare fixed-budget baseline, molecule-only and knowledge-adapter variants under the same locked split.
Evaluate biologically authentic matched-context outcomes before making RNA-to-function claims.
Assess sequential decision benefit using a policy comparison and an independently defined utility; do not infer it from RNA correlation.

verification.paper_to_source_findings: Targeted reading and static inspection; no checkpoint execution or prospective validation performed.
